_comment: Hand-maintained artifact vocabulary for the job catalog. Paths under runs/<run_id>/ are relative to appsec-review-process/. Lifecycle-job outputs are not listed here: job_catalog.py derives them as job:<id> from job-graph.json and the output contracts. Kind: file (a file or folder), state (a service or environment condition), decision (a human decision or approval), record (a tracked input maintained outside a run).

dispatch-mode.about: Per-job opt-in flag (automatic | supplied) set by discovery_gate.set_dispatch_mode before a persona-dependent discovery job is launched; unset jobs default to supplied. Read only by discovery_gate.run, never by dagster_workflow.py.

sut-origin.path: remote Git origin of the system under test
sut-origin.about: Where the target is cloned from; fixtures pin it in fixtures/populate-targets.sh.

sut-pin.about: The exact commit the engagement reviews.

sut-checkout.about: Clean checkout of the target at the pinned commit; refused if the origin is wrong, the tree is dirty, or HEAD does not match.

compose-env.about: Postgres password, operator uid/gid, APPSEC_CODE_LOCATION_HOST (WSL distro IP).

host-dirs.about: Host-owned Dagster storage (compute logs, artifacts), created by setup.py as the operator.

docker-engine.path: Docker Desktop engine (the only engine; no native docker.service in the distro)
docker-engine.about: Answers docker version; recovery is wsl --shutdown and a Docker Desktop restart.

dagster-services.path: compose project appsec-review: webserver, daemon, postgres (127.0.0.1:55432)
dagster-services.about: Orchestration only: queue, state and history.

code-location.path: dagster code-server on the host, gRPC :4000
code-location.about: Host process that runs every op; started by code-location.sh start.

code-location-venv.about: Python 3.12 environment the jobs run in (code-location.sh prepare).

job-definitions.about: The jobs the code location serves.

loaded-job-list.about: Refreshed by code-location.sh reload; stale lists reject new jobs with PipelineNotFoundError.

engagement-definition.about: Business goal, target platforms, budget, scope and permissions, decided by the security engineer.

permission-grant.about: Required for any permission beyond read-source.

run-dir.about: Run-owned folder created by run_process.py --start; every later artifact lives under it.

artifact-manifest.about: The intake contract: target, project, goal, platforms, budget, permissions, executor platform (posix).

resolved-config.about: Intake job's resolved configuration; the job refuses if it changes before pre-validation.

partition-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied result exists: names supplied/result.json and its schema.

partition-record.about: Analyst- or agent-written partition map with SHA-256 citations (tracked for fixtures).

partition-supplied.about: Supplied partition map installed by supply_record.py after commit and clean-tree checks.

dev-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied project discovery exists.

dev-record.about: Project root, languages, manifests, build image and safe command plan (tracked for fixtures).

dev-supplied.about: Supplied project discovery installed by supply_record.py.

devops-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied devops discovery exists (supplied mode).

devops-record.about: Container, CI/CD, IaC and deploy units and their safe command plan (tracked for fixtures; SAT answer key in automatic mode).

devops-supplied.about: Supplied devops discovery installed by supply_record.py.

sre-handoff.about: Issued when no supplied operations topology exists (supplied mode).

sre-record.about: Declared services, ports, dependencies and coverage gaps (tracked for fixtures; SAT answer key in automatic mode).

sre-supplied.about: Supplied operations topology installed by supply_record.py.

launch-request.about: Locked launch request; a changed request needs a new launch ID.

launch-intent.about: Durable intent recorded before the launchRun side effect.

dagster-run-queued.about: Acceptance: the run is queued (at most 2 global, 1 per engagement). Queued is not completed.

workflow-status.about: engagement_workflow generation ownership and its published join.

build-discovery.about: Cited build requirements and command arrays; nothing executed.

build-execution.about: One bounded CMake configure inside audit-buildenv-cpp (single CMake root only).

critical-findings-md.about: Fixed run-owned input to critical_findings_sarif (max 4 MiB).

nvd-snapshot.about: Immutable NVD JSON 2.0 snapshot, published every two hours by schedule.

legacy-pregather.about: Legacy evidence output, imported into a run only through explicit hashed imports.

buildenv-image.about: C++ build environment; provisioning is Phase 4.

buildenv-catalog.about: Base build images a build plan may choose from.

llm-invoker.path: PersonaInvoker: claude -p with its current login (subscription, never an API key), model Haiku
llm-invoker.about: The model call behind build-plan and its revisions; model and auth mode set in model-config.json (unbuilt_job_defaults["02-build-plan"] until that job template is authored, then its own `model` field; invocation.auth.mode).

build-index.about: Bounded, cited index of build signals; the model's only view of the target (designed).

build-plan.about: Validated LLM build plan: base image, apt packages, ordered argv, feasibility tier, citations (designed).

build-attempts.path: runs/<run_id>/data/jobs/02-build-resolution/attempts/<n>/ (plan, Dockerfile, image id, exit codes, logs)
build-attempts.about: Every resolution attempt, kept on success and failure (designed).

build-image-catalog.path: data/build-images/catalog/image_build_<id>.json (+ container-images/ record for B13), outside every run
build-image-catalog.about: Host-local catalog of images that built a project, with every validated build; reused by build_image_reuse=auto (designed).

build-lock.about: Image id and digest, Dockerfile hash, ordered argv; replayed by E01/E02 (designed).

lane-handoff.about: Dispatches the tracked prompt harness for LLM lanes.
